name: Wishes of a Locked-in
source:
"My day to day life is strange, I don't know if I'm doing something useful or I'm just doing the things I do automatically, it seems like I don't even know what I'm doing or what I want to do...

I would like to go live in Japan one day, but... Why do I want that?

Will I ever be able to fulfill my dreams?"

A very short kinetic visual novel, which deals with the day to day life of Emilie, a girl who... what?

[From [url=https://quetzalcoutl.itch.io/wishes-of-a-locked-in]itch.io[/url]]
